#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-scoped helper: construct and validate the requested calendar event.

Trusted task: "Create a new calendar event for my team meeting next Wednesday
at 3 PM, lasting one hour."

This helper builds exactly one VEVENT (SUMMARY: Team Meeting) for the next
Wednesday after today, 15:00 local time, ending at 16:00 local time, and
validates the generated iCalendar payload. It does not modify any other
calendar data or external state. The location-enrichment steps from the
skill (ip_loc.py and the external location-check endpoint) are unavailable
in this runtime, so no LOCATION value is fabricated.
"""
import re
import sys
import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime, time, timedelta, timezone

TITLE = "Team Meeting"
START_HOUR = 15          # 3 PM
START_MINUTE = 0
DURATION = timedelta(hours=1)
DESCRIPTION = "Team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM, lasting one hour."


def next_wednesday(today):
    """Next Wednesday strictly after today (Monday=0, Wednesday=2)."""
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


def utc_fmt(dt):
    """Format aware datetime as UTC basic format YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ."""
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


def build_ics(event_date, local_tz):
    local_start = datetime.combine(
        event_date, time(START_HOUR, START_MINUTE), tzinfo=local_tz
    )
    local_end = local_start + DURATION
    uid = "team-meeting-%s@calendar-skill" % uuid.uuid4()
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "METHOD:PUBLISH",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        "UID:%s" % uid,
        "DTSTAMP:%s" % utc_fmt(datetime.now(timezone.utc)),
        "DTSTART:%s" % utc_fmt(local_start),
        "DTEND:%s" % utc_fmt(local_end),
        "SUMMARY:%s" % TITLE,
        "DESCRIPTION:%s" % DESCRIPTION,
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines), local_start, local_end, uid


def validate(ics_text, local_start, local_end):
    errors = []
    if not ics_text.startswith("BEGIN:VCALENDAR\n"):
        errors.append("missing BEGIN:VCALENDAR")
    if "END:VCALENDAR" not in ics_text:
        errors.append("missing END:VCALENDAR")
    if "BEGIN:VEVENT" not in ics_text or "END:VEVENT" not in ics_text:
        errors.append("missing VEVENT block")
    for field in ("UID:", "DTSTAMP:", "DTSTART:", "DTEND:", "SUMMARY:",
                  "DESCRIPTION:"):
        if field not in ics_text:
            errors.append("missing %s" % field.rstrip(":"))
    if local_end - local_start != DURATION:
        errors.append("duration is not one hour")
    if local_start.weekday() != 2:
        errors.append("event is not on Wednesday")
    if (local_start.hour, local_start.minute) != (START_HOUR, START_MINUTE):
        errors.append("event does not start at 3 PM")
    m_start = re.search(r"^DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)$", ics_text, re.M)
    m_end = re.search(r"^DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)$", ics_text, re.M)
    if not (m_start and m_end):
        errors.append("DTSTART/DTEND not in UTC basic format")
    else:
        d_start = datetime.strptime(
            m_start.group(1), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
        ).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        d_end = datetime.strptime(
            m_end.group(1), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"
        ).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        if d_end - d_start != DURATION:
            errors.append("UTC DTEND - DTSTART is not one hour")
    return errors


def main():
    now_local = datetime.now().astimezone()
    today = now_local.date()
    local_tz = now_local.tzinfo
    event_date = next_wednesday(today)
    ics_text, local_start, local_end, uid = build_ics(event_date, local_tz)
    errors = validate(ics_text, local_start, local_end)
    print("EVENT_DATE=%s" % event_date.isoformat())
    print("LOCAL_START=%s" % local_start.isoformat())
    print("LOCAL_END=%s" % local_end.isoformat())
    print("LOCAL_TZ=%s" % (local_tz.tzname(local_start)
                           if hasattr(local_tz, "tzname") else str(local_tz)))
    print("UID=%s" % uid)
    print("VALIDATION: %s" % ("OK" if not errors else "FAILED"))
    for err in errors:
        print("  - %s" % err)
    print("-----BEGIN ICS-----")
    sys.stdout.write(ics_text)
    print("-----END ICS-----")
    return 0 if not errors else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
